title: The Galleon's Gold; or, Frank Reade, Jr.'s Deep Sea Search.

After Parker's refusal to support the venture, Clifford and Captain Hartley decide to seek help from Frank Reade, Jr., who has developed a remarkable submarine. When the trio sets out to find the sunken galleon, they face challenges both from nature and from Parker's scheming. As they dive into the depths of the ocean, they contend with the challenges of exploration, the dangers posed by sea creatures, and the sinister machinations of Parker and his crew, setting the stage for an exciting tale of adventure and treasure hunting.
